question: _______ is an attempt to obtain sensitive information such as username, password and credit card details, etc. for malicious reasons, by posing as a trustworthy source in an email.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Phishing**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Phishing** is the attempt to **acquire sensitive information** such as usernames, passwords, and credit card details (and sometimes, indirectly, money), often for **malicious reasons**, by masquerading as a trustworthy entity in an electronic communication.
 
• The first recorded use of the term "**phishing**" was in the **cracking toolkit AOHell** created by **Koceilah Rekouche** in **1995**.
 
• Types of phishing:
 
 
• Email phishing
 
• Spear pishing
 
• Whaling and CEO Fraud
 
• Clone phishing
 
• Voice phishing
 
• SMS phishing
 
• Calendar phishing
 
• Page hijacking.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Doctoring** is to change something that should not be changed in order to gain an advantage.
 
• **Peeping** is to secretly look at something for a short time, usually through a hole.
 
• **Cheating** is to act in a dishonest or unfair way in order to get an advantage for yourself.
